HAMDEN, Conn. (WFSB) - A new Quinnipiac University national poll shows 34% of voters approve of the way President Trump is handling his job, while 61% disapprove.

The disapproval rating matches an all-time high last reached in a Quinnipiac poll on Jan. 18, 2021, when 34% of voters approved of the way Trump was handling his job and 61% disapproved.

On the situation with Iran, 28% of voters approve of Trump’s handling of the issue, while 66% disapprove.
